static_traits.name: Zhang Ming
static_traits.family_status: Married有子Female，积极参与孩子的体育活动
static_traits.social_status: 与参与体育活动的其他家长的关系受影响；有书友会与家长Teacher协会的朋友但not yet分享感受
static_traits.medical_history: No major physical illness；without既往心理咨询/治疗；以往not yet出现类似问题
static_traits.language_features: 表达清晰、逻辑连贯；对咨询持怀疑态度；Self-denial明显；Not mentioned语速等细节

basic_info.main_problem: 我觉得每次开车送孩子去参加体育比赛时我总是迟到，这让我相信自己是without用的。
basic_info.core_demands: 当自卑感开始影响自尊和整体幸福感、影响我享受日常活动的能力时，我决定寻求咨询，希望改善准时性并缓解“我not用”的感受。
growth_experiences: 两年前孩子开始参加更多体育活动，需要每周多次接送并同时管理多重日程；起初压力中等，随着迟到频繁，自认为“辜负孩子”的信念逐渐Reinforcement，影响了与其他家长的关系并增加了压力与Anxiety。

core_beliefs: I am not good enough，not能胜任Father角色

special_situations.event: Arrives late when frequently shuttling children to sports activities
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我not准时，就说明I am a failureFather/without用的人
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Tightening schedule management, setting reminders, planning routes and times in advance
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我又迟到了，我就是without用的，孩子会被我辜负

special_situations.event: At the field or training site, sees other parents all able to arrange their children's activities punctually and calmly
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 必须与其他家长一样表现Good，否则就证明I am not good enough
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoids communicating with other parents to avoid being judged
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我not如他们，They must think I am incompetent

special_situations.event: Facing multiple schedules needing coordination at the same time (multiple children, multiple activities)
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我not能完美处理所有安排，就完全not行
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Tries to arrange all tasks perfectly in one go
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我根本搞not定这些安排，我总是迟到

special_situations.event: Even after investing much effort in planning, lateness still occurs
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果努力have not立刻见效，就说明我本质上without能
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: negate自己的进步和投入，进一步自责

core_conflict.wish: Longing to be a competent, recognized good father
core_conflict.fear: 害怕被其他家长或孩子视为without能、害怕让孩子失望并遭到羞辱
defense_goal: 通过Avoids socializing与自我苛责来保护自尊，减少被评价的风险

object_relations.object_representation: 批判、看not起我的他人（其他家长）

object_relations.self_representation: A caregiver who disappoints the children
object_relations.object_representation: A child who needs my good care

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When interacting with other parents at my child's competitions or training venues, or when thinking about their views
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 来访者潜意识认为他人会像评判者一样看not起自己（移情：Projection）
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: use支持性、非评判的语气；邀请其举证与Clarification具体事实，避免贴标签；以温和QuestioningGuidance其区分他人真实反馈与自己的推测。

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor proposes trying cognitive restructuring or behavioral experiments to change beliefs
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 来访者认为改变without效，自己注定“not行”（移情：deny）
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 保持稳定、接纳的语气；先Empathy其怀疑，再提出小步试验的建议；避免强迫说服，强调自主选择与节奏。

manifestations: Feels daily life has changed from enjoyment to 'endurance', hard to gain satisfaction from activities
not愿向书友会或家长Teacher协会的朋友分享感受
Avoiding communication with other parents at the competition venue, feeling embarrassed and humiliated

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: 频繁自责、给自己贴上“我not用”的标签
在Social situations过度担心他人评价而Withdrawal

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'
manifestations: 认为其他家长“看not起我”“They must think I am incompetent”

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the impulse to act toward other people or objects, or gives up seeking others to do something for them and instead does it to themselves; that is, the individual redirects energy originally intended outward toward themselves, corresponding to 'impulse'.
manifestations: 避免与其他家长交流，not向朋友求助
Turns the need for outward expression into self-reproach and internal depletion

positive_force: Actively involved in the children's sports activities, willing to spend a lot of time picking up and dropping off
Willing to seek professional help (starting counseling)
Tries to organize the schedule and set reminders, with some time-management awareness
拥有潜在的Social support资源（书友会、家长Teacher协会的朋友）
negative_force: 自我评价消极，长期给自己贴上“without用”的标签
与他人比较并读心，倾向个人化，导致Avoids socializing
Black-and-white thinking and overgeneralization, equating being late with 'complete failure'
Anxiety与Increased stress，影响日常活动的享受与参与

target_behavior.behavior: Social avoidance（在孩子的比赛或训练现场避免与其他家长交流）
antecedent: Seeing other parents at competitions/training sites
想到他人可能评判自己not称职
target_behavior.core_reason: Mind reading and personalization cognitions cause shame and inferiority; avoidance reduces situational pressure
target_behavior.function: 逃避not受欢迎的事物（他人评价、羞耻感）
target_behavior.consequence: Interpersonal relationships受损，Reduced social support，Loneliness与自卑加剧

target_behavior.behavior: 自我贬损的言语与反复自责（如“我not用”“I am not good enough”），伴随Anxiety
antecedent: 尝试组织仍not yet完全按时
target_behavior.core_reason: 黑白思维、过度概括与Introjection的“必须准时”的规则
target_behavior.function: 短期释放内疚与Anxiety的紧张感，但维持负性自我图式
target_behavior.consequence: Decreased self-esteem、Anxiety持续，进一步影响时间管理与家庭互动
